independence.policy: Social Bots must remain fully functional without SwarmAI; any future integration requires separate explicit owner authorization.

worker_lanes.note: Active Claude Code development sessions are proven by fresh signed commits. This is not evidence of V0.7 always-on Social Bots worker liveness.

tests.lead_note: Worker-local test counts are useful evidence but are not independent CI. SB-CTL-006 remains ready after V0.3 correctness repair.

key_findings: V03-004 fence protects main state/effects, but decision log/latest-decision writes remain outside the fence and filesystem multi-write effects are not transactional.
V03-005 still shares hypotheses and consumed_signal_ids across personas on one runtime, allowing cross-persona learning and signal-consumption contamination.
V04 real adaptive provider remains unverified; deterministic contextual provider is explicitly adaptive=false.
V05-001 live provenance is forgeable through arbitrary custom Fetcher(mode=live); live URL path also needs SSRF/redirect/extraction validity controls.
V05-002 trusts caller-supplied stance instead of an attributable support assessor.
V13-001 still lacks snapshot/delta/gauge/rate semantics and cumulative-safe aggregation.
V14-001 lacks persona scope; sensitive-segment blacklist is bypassable; contradiction does not justify arbitrary fork support.
V15-001 measurements are caller numeric dicts without normalized-observation/evidence refs.
V16-001 factual binding is presence-only and history/novelty is bot-wide.
V17-001 read-only evidence and community themes are caller/bot scoped rather than receipt/persona scoped.
V20-002 accepts arbitrary numeric performance/audience inputs instead of typed accepted evidence artifacts.
